name: zcode-statusline
description: Toolbar-style usage footer for ZCode: appends a one-line status bar (turns, steps, tok/s, session tokens, cache-hit rate) to the end of every reply, computed from the real ZCode usage database.

description_i18n.en: Toolbar-style usage footer: every reply ends with one real status line — turns, steps, tok/s, session tokens and cache-hit rate — read from the ZCode usage database.
description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 状态栏：每条回复末尾附一行真实用量（轮数、步数、tok/s、会话 token 总量、缓存命中率），数据取自 ZCode usage 数据库。
